resources.string:
WayLandIE preserves the GPU-first zero-copy path:

Linux Wayland client (game / gamescope) → dmabuf fd → waylandie.display.bridge.v1 abstract socket → Android app imports dmabuf as AHardwareBuffer via VK_ANDROID_external_memory_android_hardware_buffer → presented through SurfaceControl with USAGE_COMPOSITOR_OVERLAY → phone display.

No CPU copy on the hot path. WAYLANDIE_FINAL_COPY=forbidden is enforced.
